business_rules.name: Tenant boundary
business_rules.description: A record may reference only records belonging to the same tenant unless an approved shared-master pattern applies.

business_rules.name: Immutable primary key
business_rules.description: Primary identifiers never change after record creation.

business_rules.name: Version check
business_rules.description: Updates require the current record version.

business_rules.name: Released version immutability
business_rules.description: Released estimates, contracts, document versions, events, and audit events cannot be edited.

business_rules.name: Effective date integrity
business_rules.description: Effective start must precede effective end and overlapping active records are prohibited where uniqueness applies.

business_rules.name: Money context
business_rules.description: A monetary amount must include currency.

business_rules.name: Quantity context
business_rules.description: A quantity must include compatible unit and dimension.

business_rules.name: Source preservation
business_rules.description: Imported values preserve source system, external identifier, import batch, and original value where transformed.

business_rules.name: AI writeback approval
business_rules.description: AI recommendations do not change authoritative records until the required approval is completed.

business_rules.name: Document checksum
business_rules.description: Accepted document content must have a validated checksum.

business_rules.name: Party master merge
business_rules.description: A party merge preserves all source identifiers, relationships, addresses, contacts, and reversal evidence.
business_rules.action: Create surviving master and merge history

business_rules.name: No silent data correction
business_rules.description: Failed quality or validation rules create explicit exceptions or rejected rows.

business_rules.name: Lifecycle integrity
business_rules.description: Inactive or archived master data cannot be assigned to new work unless policy permits.

business_rules.name: Audit completeness
business_rules.description: Material create, update, archive, merge, approve, import, and AI writeback actions create audit events.

business_rules.name: Retention inheritance
business_rules.description: A record inherits retention from classification, entity type, and governing jurisdiction.
